title: Lower ME: Front Squat + Speed
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Front Squat 3 · 3-sec pause @ RPE 8 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Isometric wk 1: dead-stop 3-sec pause at the bottom, no bounce · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · elbows high
note: Isometric phase: 3-second dead-stop pause at the bottom of every main-lift rep. Heavier again.
